alex: quick heads-up — tidal17b-int4 canary is hitting intermittent CUDA OOMs during long multi-turn sessions (>1200 tokens). Reject rate ~1.8% on canary-2 this morning. anyone on call to triage? :thinking:

	nina: can you paste the minimal error / context?

	alex: log snippet:```
	2026-05-03T07:41:02Z worker-12 ERROR cudaMalloc failed: out of memory	alloc_chunk=1.1MB	free_slots=2	max_new_tokens=768	batch=6	prefetch=on
	callstack: serve->kv_prefetch->alloc_chunk
	```

	omar: sounds like fragmentation more than steady-state mem. int4 reduces base weight but increases many small per-step allocations. low-risk mitigations: drop model default max_new_tokens 768->320, set microbatch.soft_cap=4, lower kv_evict_threshold 0.65. also try freelist_coalesce=on for one canary worker.

	jada: we also observed a small ROUGE-L dip (~1.5) on our long-summary suite with current int4 config. ran `/evals/run_quality.py --model tidal17b --quant int4 --suite long-summ --seed 13` last night. int8 matched fp16 within noise.

	priya: I'm starting a targeted sweep (int4 vs int8 vs fp16) and will push artifacts to gs://redwood-evals/tidal17b/1745559999/. Will include sample diffs and metric deltas. ETA ~2h.

	ci-bot: deploy note: tidal17b-int4 v2026.05.03.07 deployed to pool-canary-2 (sha: bea7c1).

	nina: I'll repro locally with the failing prompt set: `python tools/repro_oom.py --model tidal17b --quant int4 --prompt tests/long_chat.json --batch 6 --max_new_tokens 768` and capture tracemalloc + nvprof. ETA 90m.

	omar: I'll flip freelist_coalesce=on for canary-4 and leave canary-5 as control, and patch defaults: max_new_tokens=320, microbatch.soft_cap=4. Will report memory histograms after 30m.

	sre-alerts: paging policy active: pages on >1% 5xx in 5m window for tidal17b.

	alex: plan: (1) nina repro & upload traces (ETA 90m), (2) priya quality sweep (ETA 2h), (3) omar patch canary config and enable freelist_coalesce on one worker (ETA 30m). If quality delta >2 pts on critical suites we route long-chat to tidal17b-int8 (route rule: ctx_estimate>1200 -> int8). Update this thread with artifacts. :thumbsup:

	jada: noted. I'll also run a quick eval focusing on length-truncation artifacts with current max_new_tokens to see if truncation is amplifying the metric drop.

	priya: sweep started, pushing interim results now. int4 shows ROUGE-L -1.6 vs fp16 on long-summ when max_new_tokens >= 768; int8 aligns with fp16. Full report link: gs://redwood-evals/tidal17b/1745559999/report.html

	nina: repro traces uploaded: gs://redwood-traces/tidal17b/repro_1745559999.zip. nvprof & tracemalloc confirm repeated small allocs at alloc_chunk during KV prefetch — fragmentation pattern.

	omar: memory histograms: control worker still had 1 OOM in 40m, freelist_coalesce worker had zero OOMs and lower free_slot variance. I'm opening PR with config changes and a conservative rollout plan.

	alex: good signal. prefer conservative defaults + routing for long-chat over reverting quant. @priya please attach example mismatches in the eval report so product can assess user impact. We'll revisit per-layer quant options if needed. Closing loop once PR + routing roll to canary.
